verdict.rationale: Financial Connections lets a linked bank account be used to collect ACH Direct Debit payments (docs-8, docs-16, docs-17, docs-27-29), which is a debit-based bank payment initiation flow, but this is not a full 'pay-by-bank' push-payment product, and there is no documented statement of live geographies — the only geography signal comes from community reports that it is US-only (comm-9, comm-11, comm-12), not honest first-party docs. Missing for 10: explicit documented geography/coverage list, and evidence of true push-payment (real-time transfer) initiation rather than just ACH debit collection.
